lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The skills speak in terms of five canonical triage roles. This file maps those roles to the actual label strings used in this repo's issue tracker.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: | Label in mattpocock/skills | Label in our tracker | Meaning                                  |

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: | `needs-triage`             | `needs-triage`       | Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue  |

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: | `needs-info`               | `needs-info`         | Waiting on reporter for more information |

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: | `ready-for-agent`          | `ready-for-agent`    | Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent  |

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: When a skill mentions a role, such as "apply the AFK-ready triage label", use the corresponding label string from this table.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Edit the right-hand column to match whatever vocabulary you actually use.
